Other polystyrene sulfonate resins include calcium polystyrene sulfonate (p.1438), which is used similarly to the sodium resin and potassium polystyrene sul- fonate (p.1460), which has been used in the treatment of hypercalciuria. Aluminium polystyrene sulfonate, ammonium polystyrene sulfonate, and magnesium polystyrene sulfonate have all occasionally been used. Preparations USP 31: Sodium Polystyrene Sulfonate Suspension.
